P20 (overflow threshold gte -> gt) survived and is killed by testPowExactlyAtTheOverflowThreshold: a = (int224.max / 10 + 1) 10^int32.max, b = 1 + 465661273184989617541055125131739873881019438247110325622e-66 makes the leg exactly 10^1, so the unrounded power is exactly the threshold. Equivalent: Q02 (pow10 window 10 -> 9: the pow10 coefficient is 1 or at most 1e41, so at exponent int32.max - 9 the value is at most 10^(int32.max + 32), far below the threshold), Q04 (pow10 drops lossless: its coefficient is 1 or at least 1e40, never zero, and packLossy returns a lossless zero only for a zero coefficient), P07 (76 -> 77: int256(10**77) wraps negative, so every positive integer b still reverts; as M11), P08 (> -> >=: at the boundary b is at least 5e76 and every a but 1 is at least 1e-67 from 1, so |b log10 a| >= 2.17e9, past both range ends by 2.4e7 decades against under 75 decades of truncation; the squaring and pack path reverts the same side and payload; as M12), P27 (sqrt reports one half: b = 0.5 has integer part 0, so neither the integer-b check nor the squaring loop runs, and a negative a reverts PowNegativeBase first; input is never read). Open: P21 (negative side lte -> lt) differs only at exactly -(int224.max / 10 + 1) 10^(int32.max + 1), reachable only through a negative a, which forces an integer b. b = 1 returns a, which is packable. An exact c^N needs the squarefree M = 13 149 593 3109 184481113 231769777 1398316729 4345052821 1453030298001690873541 to be an Nth power. b = -1 has no maximized divisor (a multiple of 1e9) inside the inverse window. A truncated product for N >= 2 is not ruled out, so it is neither killed nor proven. threshold.log killed it only through a test that widened revertIfPastLargestFloat to internal; that was discarded with its two proptest seeds, which a mutant run had written.

P21 (negative side lte -> lt) of the 02a621b entry has no target any more: there is one gte on |value|, and S13 (gte -> gt) is killed by testPowExactlyAtTheOverflowThreshold, so the exact threshold is pinned for both signs. S11 (negation dropped) was killed only by fuzz (testRoundTripFuzzPow, exact_pow); testPowNegativeOddPowerPastTheRange now kills it deterministically: (-2e715827905)^3 overflows through the carry-fallback check and (-2e715827950)^3 through the rounded check, each reporting a, and (-2e715827904)^3 is -8e65 10^int32.max. Equivalent, all from |rounded| <= 1e41 (roundSignificant keeps at most 41 digits): S01 (excess > 0 -> >= 0) and S02 (> 0 -> > 1): for excess up to 25 the lift check needs |rounded| > int224.max / 10^excess >= 1.3e42 and the threshold needs |rounded| 10^excess >= 1.3e67, so neither fires and the same packLossy runs. S03 (excess <= 67 -> < 67): at excess 67, |rounded| >= 2 overflows on the rounded check, and the unrounded is at least 1.5 10^(int32.max + 67), past the threshold of 1.35 10^(int32.max + 67), so the fallback reverts the same; |rounded| = 1 lifts on both. S04 (67 -> 68, as M24): int224.max / 1e68 is 0, so every nonzero rounded value fails the lift, and both it and its unrounded value overflow. S10 (< 0 -> <= 0): negating zero is zero. S21 (pow10 window 10 -> 9, as Q02) and S22 (10 -> 11): the check reverts only past the threshold, which packLossy also refuses, and the pow10 coefficient is at most 1e41, so at exponent int32.max - 9 or lower the value is at most 10^(int32.max + 32) and the check never fires.
